---
title: "PIRUS"
output: html_document
---

```{r}
# Load libraries
library(readr)
library(tidyverse)
```


```{r}
# Load code
PIRUSV5 <- read_csv("PIRUSV5.csv")
View(PIRUSV5)
```

How is perceived group grievance related to the depth of ideological commitment among people in PIRUS?
```{r}
# Clean the data
grievance_data <- PIRUSV5 %>%
  filter(
    Group_Grievance >= 0,
    Radical_Beliefs >= 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Group_Grievance = factor(
      Group_Grievance,
      levels = c(0, 1, 2, 3),
      labels = c(
        "No group grievance",
        "Grievance, no personal connection",
        "Grievance, personal connection",
        "Grievance, direct experience"
      )
    ),
    Radical_Beliefs = factor(
      Radical_Beliefs,
      levels = 0:5
    )
  )
```


```{r}
# Create the visualization
ggplot(grievance_data, aes(x = Group_Grievance, fill = Radical_Beliefs)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Group Grievance and Radical Beliefs",
    x = "Connection to Group Grievance",
    y = "Percentage of Individuals",
    fill = "Level of Radical Beliefs"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1)
  )

```



Is prior traumatic experience associated with how quickly radicalization develops?
```{r}
# Clean the data
trauma_data <- PIRUSV5 %>%
  filter(
    Trauma >= 0,
    Rad_duration >= 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Trauma = factor(
      Trauma,
      levels = c(0, 1, 2, 3),
      labels = c(
        "No trauma",
        "Trauma, timing unknown",
        "Trauma, long before radicalization",
        "Trauma, shortly before radicalization"
      )
    ),
    Rad_duration = factor(
      Rad_duration,
      levels = c(1, 2, 3),
      labels = c(
        "Short",
        "Medium",
        "Long"
      )
    )
  )

```

```{r}
# Create the visualization
ggplot(trauma_data, aes(x = Trauma, fill = Rad_duration)) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Trauma and the Duration of Radicalization",
    x = "Prior Traumatic Experience",
    y = "Percentage of Individuals",
    fill = "Radicalization Duration"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1)
  )
```


Is Social media frequency associated with higher level radical behaviors

```{r}
# Clean the data
social_media_data <- PIRUSV5 %>%
  filter(
    Social_Media_Frequency >= 1,
    Radical_Behaviors >= 0
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Social_Media_Frequency = factor(
      Social_Media_Frequency,
      levels = 1:5,
      labels = c(
        "Rarely",
        "Sporadically",
        "Occasionally",
        "Frequently",
        "Continually"
      )
    ),
    Radical_Behaviors = factor(
      Radical_Behaviors,
      levels = 0:10
    )
  )
```

```{r}
# Create the visualization
ggplot(
  social_media_data,
  aes(x = Social_Media_Frequency, fill = Radical_Behaviors)
) +
  geom_bar(position = "fill") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    title = "Social Media Frequency and Radical Behaviors",
    x = "Frequency of Social Media Use",
    y = "Percentage of Individuals",
    fill = "Level of Radical Behaviors"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 25, hjust = 1)
  )

```
